title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00069 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 01:00: Installed diverter
01:00 - 02:00: M/u bolts on slick joint. Meanwhile installed master bushing, performed TBT for pressure testing of riser connections
02:00 - 02:30: Filled riser and BOP w/ sea water
02:30 - 03:00: Tested riser connector to 20/310 bar for 5/10 min. Good test
03:00 - 03:15: Performed pre-job meeting to pull BPV
03:15 - 03:30: M/u BPV retrieving tool to stand of 3,5in DP
03:30 - 04:00: Pulled BPV dart to the rig floor
04:00 - 04:45: Pulled BPV to the rig floor. L/d BPV retrieving tool
04:45 - 05:00: Performed pre-job meeting to instal THRT
05:00 - 06:00: Rigged up 7in TBG handling equipment
06:00 - 07:00: P/u top 7in TBG joint and m/u to weco 1502 swedge. L/d same
07:00 - 07:15: Performed pre-job meeting to p/u and RIH THRT
07:15 - 08:15: P/u and m/u tubing hanger running tool, joint and joint Connected control lines
08:15 - 09:15: Engaged THRT and took 2. 5ton overpull test. OK
09:15 - 09:30: M/u cement line to swedge and tested same to 100bar. OK
09:30 - 10:30: Pressured up control line to DHSV to 520bar. Pressured up above DHSV to 100bar w/ cement unit. DHSV did not open. Bled off pressure above DHSV. Closed LTV and retested line from cement unit to 250bar. OK. Pressured up above DHSV to 120bar, DHSV opened. Bled off pressure from the well. Rigged down cement hose and LTV
10:30 - 10:45: Performed pre-job meeting to r/u WL
10:45 - 11:45: R/u wireline equipment
11:45 - 12:45: RIH w/ run 5,375" od cutter from 0 m to 1500 m. Average running speed 25 m/min
12:45 - 13:15: RIH w/ run 5,375" od cutter from 1500 m to 2500 m. Average running speed 33 m/min
13:15 - 14:00: RIH w/ run 5,375" od cutter from 2500 m to 3086 m. Average running speed 13 m/min
14:00 - 15:00: Logged from 3086m to 2923m. RIH back to 3086m. Attempted to pass 3086m, no-go
15:00 - 15:15: Evaluated situation. Discussed situation w/ onshore organisation
15:15 - 15:30: Positioned cutter at 3075 m Performed cut. Observed 200l backflow at rotary
